content: उपोद्घातः .²1 A beginning, commencement. .²2 An introduction, a preface. .²3 An example, an apposite argument or illustration. .²4 An occasion, medium, means; तत्प्रतिच्छन्दकमुपोद्घातेन माधवान्तिकमुपेयात् <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²5 Analysis, ascertaining the elements of anything. .²6 Alluding to, mentioning; <ls>Mu. 3</ls>.
